Educated Progressive Conservationist.name: Educated Progressive Conservationist
Educated Progressive Conservationist.description: High education and income; high trust in science; strongly pro-environmental protection; analyzes data centers through climate grid decarbonization, corporate accountability, and environmental justice.

Traditional Pro-Growth Property Conserva.name: Traditional Pro-Growth Property Conservative
Traditional Pro-Growth Property Conserva.description: Conservative and pro-market; skeptical of environmental over-regulation; open to data center infrastructure for local commercial tax revenues and job growth, provided private property rights are respected.

Vulnerable Working-Class Community Defen.name: Vulnerable Working-Class Community Defender
Vulnerable Working-Class Community Defen.description: Lower-income and working-class; highly vulnerable to electricity rate increases and water resource competition; prioritizes immediate household economic protection and local community health.

Conservative Conservationist & Ratepayer.name: Conservative Conservationist & Ratepayer Skeptic
Conservative Conservationist & Ratepayer.description: Right-leaning partisan who paradoxically demands strong environmental protection for local water tables, farmland, and rural quiet; fierce opponent of utility monopolies externalizing grid costs onto residential taxpayers.
